name: Fuudey – Restaurant Menu – Ordering – Reservations
author: Atendant

sections.description:
Upgrade your service in 4 minutes – trusted by 1,200+ happy restaurants across 100 countries, with 900+ reviews. Fuudey is the award-winning all-in-one digital menu & QR platform, by Atendant.

Fuudey turns your WordPress site into a complete restaurant ordering system in minutes – a beautiful digital menu, online ordering for dine-in, pickup and delivery, QR-code table ordering, table reservations, and a customer chat. You keep 100% of every order: no commissions, no per-order fees, and no coding.

Add one shortcode (or the Fuudey block) to any page and your customers can browse the menu, build their order, and check out – right on your own website.

Why restaurants choose Fuudey

  • Zero commission – keep all your revenue; no cut taken on any order
  • No setup headaches – one click creates your account and venue; you’re live in minutes
  • Your brand, your site – orders happen on your domain, not a third-party marketplace
  • Works with any theme – drop it into your existing WordPress site, no rebuild needed

What you get

  • Beautiful digital menu – categories, photos, descriptions, modifiers and prices, fully responsive on phone, tablet and desktop
  • Online ordering – accept orders for dine-in, pickup and delivery directly from your site
  • QR code ordering – print a QR code per table so guests order and pay from their phones
  • Table reservations – let customers book a table in a few taps
  • Customer chat – an optional floating chat bubble on your site so visitors can message you; you reply from the Fuudey manager dashboard
  • Payments – take payment by card (Stripe), PayPal, or cash / pay-on-collection
  • Order management dashboard – see and manage every order in real time, with statuses and history
  • Kitchen display – send live orders straight to the kitchen
  • Promotions & coupons – run discount codes, deals and special offers
  • Delivery zones – set delivery areas, fees and minimum order amounts
  • Multi-location – run several venues from one account
  • 30+ languages – serve your customers in their language

Flexible placement

Each Fuudey button or embed is its own shortcode. Add as many as you like – a floating order button in your header, an inline menu embedded in a page, a full-page menu, a chat bubble, or a button that opens in a new tab. Point each one at the menu, a specific order type (dine-in, pickup, delivery), reservations, or your manager dashboard.

How it works

  1. Install & activate the plugin from your WordPress dashboard
  2. Click Start on the Fuudey setup page – your venue is created using your WordPress admin email (or connect an existing venue)
  3. Build your menu – add categories, items, prices and photos in the Fuudey dashboard
  4. Add it to your site – paste a shortcode (e.g. [ordering_12345]) on any page, or use the Fuudey block
  5. Start taking orders – customers order and pay without ever leaving your website

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.9 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

External services

This plugin connects your WordPress site to the Fuudey ordering platform (https://fuudey.com), operated by Atendant. Fuudey is the service that powers the menu display, online ordering, reservations, customer chat, and the order-management dashboard – the plugin acts as a bridge between your site and that platform. The platform’s API runs on Google Cloud (cloudfunctions.net).

What is sent, and when:

  • When you click Start on the plugin’s setup page (and only then): your WordPress admin email, site name, site URL and site logo are sent to the Fuudey API (Google Cloud, cloudfunctions.net) to create or link your Fuudey account and venue. Nothing is sent on install or activation, and nothing is sent if you instead connect an existing venue by entering its URL.
  • On page view: when a visitor opens a Fuudey button or embed, the menu and ordering interface is loaded from https://fuudey.com (in a dialog, an inline frame, or a new tab). If you add a chat-bubble button, a small script is loaded from https://fuudey.com to draw the bubble. Information a customer enters to place an order, reservation, or chat message (such as name, table/location, items, and payment selection) is sent to and stored by Fuudey.

  • Manager links open the Fuudey management dashboard hosted at https://fuudey.com.

  • Terms of Service: https://fuudey.com/terms

  • Privacy Policy: https://fuudey.com/privacy
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Search for Fuudey
  3. Click Install Now then Activate
  4. Open the Fuudey menu in your dashboard sidebar and click Start (or connect an existing venue)
  5. Copy a shortcode (e.g. [ordering_12345]) and paste it on any page or post

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Upload the zip file and click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin
  5. Click Start under the Fuudey menu (or connect an existing venue)

Adding an order button

Using a shortcode: open the Fuudey settings, configure a button or embed, and copy its shortcode (e.g. [ordering_12345]). Paste it on any page, post, or widget area. Add more with the + tab for different order types or styles.

Using the block: edit a page, click +, search for “Fuudey”, and add the Fuudey block.

In your header: enable Show Button in WordPress Header on any button to place it in your theme’s header automatically.
sections.faq:
Is it really commission-free?

Yes. Fuudey does not take a percentage or a per-order fee on your orders. The free plan covers full menu display and ordering.

Do I need a separate account?

No – clicking Start sets up your Fuudey venue using your WordPress admin email. No separate signup required. Already have a venue? Connect it by entering its venue URL instead.

What is the customer chat?

An optional floating chat bubble you can add to your site. Visitors type a message in the bubble and you see and answer it in the Fuudey manager dashboard.

Can I customise the order button?

Yes. In the Fuudey settings, expand the styling options for any button to change colours, text, font, size, border, shadow and more.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. Fuudey works with any WordPress theme. The button and menu are self-contained.

Can I use it with WooCommerce?

Yes. Fuudey runs independently of WooCommerce, with its own ordering and payment flow built for restaurants.

How do customers pay?

Card (Stripe), PayPal, or cash / pay-on-collection. Configure payment methods in the Fuudey dashboard.

Can I run more than one location?

Yes. Create additional venues in the Fuudey dashboard and set the venue URL in the plugin settings.

Where is my data stored?

Menu and order data is stored securely on Fuudey’s servers (https://fuudey.com). See the External services section above.
sections.changelog:
1.2.0

  • Per-button shortcodes: add multiple buttons/embeds, each with its own shortcode
  • Landing page selector: menu home, dine-in, pickup, delivery, reservation, and manager pages
  • New types: full-page and new-tab buttons in addition to dialog and inline embed
  • Optional “Show Button in WordPress Header”
  • Manager auto-login links
  • Setup is now explicit: click Start (opt-in) or connect an existing venue – nothing is sent on activation

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Shortcode and block support
  • Full button styling customisation
  • Responsive menu dialog
